text: Debugging is an important skill for every programmer. When your code does not work as expected, the first step is identifying bugs. You need to find where the problem comes from and understand why it happens. Many debugging tools can help you, such as breakpoints, debuggers, and error messages. A systematic approach is also useful: check your code step by step, test small parts, and change one thing at a time. Another helpful method is logging. By adding log messages, you can see what your program is doing and find the exact moment when something goes wrong. With patience and practice, debugging becomes much easier.
